component.name: Steam Stat
component.summary: A local archive of your Steam playtime, friends and achievements
Steam 数据档案馆：把游玩时长、好友动态与成就永久保存在本机

description.p: Steam Stat keeps the Steam data that Steam itself throws away: every play session, friend activity, achievement timeline, screenshots, save backups and profile changes, stored permanently on your computer.
Steam Stat is not affiliated with Valve. It never modifies Steam data and never uploads your data.
